title: 40 袭击41 漕帮42 入微
slug: 我有装备栏460上次那一位
content_zh:
;;
傍晚。
齐知玄回到媚香楼，前脚刚进门，老鸨便叫住了他。
“大虎，近来不太平，可能会有人来我们媚香楼故意闹事，你盯着点。”
老鸨脸色微微凝重。
齐知玄心头一凛，人有旦夕祸福，事态说恶化就恶化。
“老板娘放心，我一定尽力。”
齐知玄一本正经，心里却在想着：我特么月薪不到三千，你觉得我会为你玩命吗？
媚香楼怎么样不重要，提升实力才重要。
随后。
齐知玄来到三楼，躲在角落里，苦练十三太保。
【你获得50颗精品气血丹的药效加持，气血+400%，肌肉+48%，壮骨+12.5%，抗毒+7.5%，需要持续装备145小时。】
《十三太保》被合成出来之后，齐知玄对于气血丹的吸收速度明显加快。
装备一颗精品气血丹，只需2.9小时就能完全吸收。
“从画境大成到入微，气血至少翻四倍。”
齐知玄吐出一口浊气，在吵杂喧嚣的环境里集中精神，保持专注，一遍又一遍熬炼筋骨，壮大气血。
好在。
今晚无事。
转眼又过两天，情况有变。
白狼帮派来了三位打手，漕帮也安排三位打手过来。

六位响劲武者一起来到媚香楼镇场子。
齐知玄瞬间沦为可有可无的边缘人，没人拿他当回事。
“一下来了六位高手，应该是有大事要发生。”
齐知玄心里透亮，赶紧找到舅舅曾大义，提醒他有事躲远点，千万别看热闹。
之后他又去了厨房，提醒了王二勺等人。
天彻底黑了。
媚香楼一片热闹，姑娘们轻歌曼舞，琴瑟和鸣，欢声笑语中透露着纸醉金迷。
齐知玄在大厅里巡视着。
这时，老鸨冲他挥了挥手绢，喊道：“大虎，跟我上三楼。”
很快，二人来到了花魁房门外。
老鸨先是敲门，再推门而入。
房内，花魁萧余香正坐在椅子上饮茶。
老鸨走到她身旁，嘀咕了几声，又抬手指了指齐知玄。
萧余香皱眉道：“有这么严重吗？”
老鸨叹道：“不怕一万，就怕万一。”
萧余香瞥了眼齐知玄，点点头，轻声道：“好吧，大虎还是靠得住的。”
老鸨顿时欢喜，把齐知玄喊过来，仔细说道：“大虎，接下来这段日子，你就守在花魁房门外。”
“如果有事发生，我会摇铃铛，只要你听到铃铛声，就立刻带着花魁从应急楼梯下去，走后院，去后门，我会安排一辆马车在那边等着，随时护送花魁离开这里。”
content_en:
;;
evening.
Qi Zhixuan returned to Meixiang Tower. As soon as he walked in, the madam stopped him.
"Dahu, it's not peaceful recently. Someone may come to our Meixiang Building to cause trouble intentionally. Please keep an eye on it."
The madam's face turned slightly solemn.
Qi Zhixuan's heart trembled. People are prone to misfortune and good fortune, and the situation will get worse as soon as it gets worse.
"Don't worry, boss lady, I will try my best."
Qi Zhixuan was serious, but he was thinking in his heart: My monthly salary is less than three thousand, do you think I will risk my life for you?
It doesn't matter how good Meixiang Tower is, it's important to improve your strength.
Subsequently.
Qi Zhixuan came to the third floor, hid in the corner, and worked hard to train the Thirteen Taibao.
[You get the medicinal effects of 50 high-quality Qi and Blood Pills, Qi and Blood +400%, Muscles +48%, Bone Strengthening +12.5%, Poison Resistance +7.5%, and need to be equipped continuously for 145 hours. 】
After "Thirteen Taibao" was synthesized, Qi Zhixuan's absorption of Qi and Blood Pills was significantly accelerated.
Equipped with a high-quality Qi and Blood Pill, it only takes 2.9 hours to fully absorb it.
"From the great level of painting to the subtle level, the energy and blood will at least quadruple."
Qi Zhixuan exhaled a breath of turbid air, concentrated in the noisy environment, stayed focused, exercised his muscles and bones over and over again, and strengthened his qi and blood.
Good thing.
Nothing to do tonight.
In the blink of an eye, two days later, the situation changed.
Three thugs came from the White Wolf Gang, and the Cao Gang also arranged for three thugs to come over.
Six Xiangjin warriors came to the Meixiang Tower town together.
Qi Zhixuan was instantly reduced to a peripheral person, and no one took him seriously.
"Six masters are here at once, something big is about to happen."
Qi Zhixuan felt enlightened and quickly found his uncle Zeng Dayi and reminded him to stay away if something happened and not to watch the fun.
After that, he went to the kitchen and reminded Wang Ershao and others.
It was completely dark.
Meixiang Tower was bustling with excitement, the girls were singing and dancing, playing the piano and the harp in harmony, and the laughter revealed the excitement.
Qi Zhixuan was patrolling the hall.
At this time, the madam waved his handkerchief at him and shouted: "Dahu, follow me to the third floor."
Soon, the two came to the door of the oiran's room.
The madam first knocked on the door and then pushed in.
In the room, the oiran Xiao Yuxiang was sitting on a chair drinking tea.
The madam walked to her side, murmured a few times, and then raised her finger to point at Qi Zhixuan.
Xiao Yuxiang frowned and said, "Is it that serious?"
The old bustard sighed: "Don't be afraid of ten thousand, just be afraid of what happens."
Xiao Yuxiang glanced at Qi Zhixuan, nodded, and said softly: "Okay, Dahu is still reliable."
The old bustard was immediately happy, called Qi Zhixuan over, and said carefully: "Dahu, for the next few days, you will stay outside the door of the oiran's room."
"If something happens, I will ring the bell. As soon as you hear the bell, immediately take the oiran down the emergency stairs, walk to the backyard, and go to the back door. I will arrange for a carriage to wait there and escort the oiran out of here at any time."
